damage_paths: farmland-only restriction in source pursuit digging; other materials unchanged
monster landing trampling; player and animal landing rules unchanged
other_exclusions: MITE and other mod namespaces, including subclasses of vanilla monsters

user_requested_modern_extension.target: FarmBlock with air or herbaceous plants/stems above; loaded chunks and real world height only

user_requested_modern_extension.crop_result: existing CropLifecycle.TRAMPLE path for managed crops; other herbaceous plants/stems removed without drops
user_requested_modern_extension.crop_source_exceptions: existing poisonous-potato rules remain authoritative; no added harvest yield
user_requested_modern_extension.combat_priority: live target blocks canUse and interrupts current work before any block mutation
user_requested_modern_extension.period_transition: ending the blood moon cancels movement/work before any crop or soil mutation
user_requested_modern_extension.ephemeral_state: path/progress are not saved; join installation is idempotent

protection.listener_mutation_guard: recheck current blood night, entity eligibility, grief/live target and both original states after event callbacks; pursuit digging and monster landing also recheck blood night and grief
